text:
sanjay: quick check-in: i want an API at the edge that helps clients decide when to show "loading" vs "partial result" vs "try fallback". thinking: a small 'lease' token + progressive-state events. thoughts?

kat: good. two implementation options: 1) trailers for end-of-stream info + occasional small SSE-style JSON chunks for progress, or 2) single header + periodic status-ping UDP-like on control channel. trailers are easier but don't help midstream.

maria: prefer SSE-like inline events on streams (but opt-in). propose minimal wire: header `X-RW-Priority: high|normal|best-effort` and `X-RW-Progress: opt-in`. progress events are newline-delimited small JSON lines, extremely sparse.

dom: must define semantics: progress is advisory not authoritative. gateway should mark `progress_source` = cache|upstream|eviction so SDKs know if it's final or not. avoid leaking model internals by default.

kat: admission rules: soft-lease model. each request gets a lease_score; high priority gets lease boost. eviction only when new admission score crosses threshold and request is below stage 'first_token'. also reserve a hard cap for high-priority so bursts don't evict everyone.
sanjay: agree. progress token idea: `lease_id=uuid; attempt=1; stage=started|first_token|partial|final; sample_bucket=25|50|75|100; source=cache|upstream`. SDKs map stage->UI. retries increment attempt.

observability-bot: note: add tags `progress.stage`, `progress.lease_id`, `progress.attempt`. alert candidate: `p95 time_to_first_token > 1.5s` for high-priority routes.
maria: privacy note: default off and opt-in at route level. for private deployments keep off unless explicitly enabled. also include sampling flag to limit metric cardinality.
dom: rollout: prototype on chat-beta, feature-flagged `lease-progress-v1`, collect telemetry for 2 weeks, tweak reserve % and emission cadence (~2s or stage-change). i'll draft the eviction knobs.

kat: one more: interaction with prefix caching9: if cache returns immediately emit `stage=final; source=cache` so clients don't show spinner. simple win.
sanjay: owners: @kat wire wire-format + SDK mapping, @maria privacy/compat docs, @dom eviction math. i'll draft RFC follow-up with examples and a tiny openapi snippet.
maria: thanks. TL;DR: opt-in progress events, lease token with attempt counter, soft-lease admission, reserve for high-priority, sampling, prototype on chat-beta. :thumbsup:
